projects.name: Corsicana Facility
projects.quote: The Corsicana Facility will have a total capacity of 1 GW when fully developed, at which point it is expected to be the largest known Bitcoin mining facility in the world by developed capacity.

projects.name: Corsicana Facility substation
projects.quote: On April 18, Riot announced the successful energization of the Corsicana Facility substation.

projects.name: Rockdale Facility
projects.quote: Bitcoin Mining revenue in excess of Bitcoin Mining cost of revenue for the quarter was $33.5 million (45% of mining revenue), as compared to $26.1 million (54% of mining revenue) for the same three-month period in 2023, an increase of $7.4 million driven by higher Bitcoin prices during the quarter and an increase in revenues from the expansion of Bitcoin mining capacity at the Rockdale Facility.

projects.name: Second order of 66,560 miners for Corsicana
projects.quote: Includes remaining $223 million on second order of 66,560 additional miners scheduled to be delivered through April 2025.
